title.description: The title of the page that lists the sermons.

description.defaultMessage: Recordings from the church's YouTube channel.
description.description: The line under the title of the page that lists the sermons: what the list is.

sync.description: The button that checks the church's YouTube channel for recordings the sermons do not hold yet, and adds each to the site.

syncing.description: The label of the sync button while the church's YouTube channel is being checked.

added.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# sermon} other {# sermons}} added.
added.description: What the sermons page says after a sync that added sermons. `count` is how many were added. Each is published, and so on the site at once.

current.description: What the sermons page says after a sync that found no recording the sermons did not already hold.

draft.description: The label of a sermon that has not been put on the site yet.

published.description: The label of a sermon that is on the site.

archived.description: The label of a sermon that was taken off the site and kept.

watch.description: The accessible name of the link beside a sermon to its recording on YouTube. `title` is the sermon's title.

allView.description: The name of the view of the sermons timeline that the admin starts with: every sermon, the latest preached first. Shown as the first tab over the timeline, beside the views a user has saved.

notFound.description: The error shown when an address names a sermon that does not exist.

details.description: The tab of a sermon's page that holds its details, its recording and what is written about it.
